offering_description.value: Develops and sells non-opioid pain management products, mainly an extended-release local anesthetic and an extended-release knee injection, to hospitals, surgery centers and orthopedic practices. It makes its products and sells them under its own brand.

primary_products.value: extended-release local anesthetic; extended-release knee injection; cryoneurolysis pain device

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, orthopedic and pain physicians

revenue_model.value: product sales: injectable drugs and a nerve-pain device sold to hospitals and clinics

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: markets its own drugs and device, sold to hospitals and clinics; OEM / manufacturer: makes its injectable drugs and device, sold to hospitals and clinics

geography_served.value: US national: sells across the United States, with some sales abroad through partners

specialization.value: related lines: pain-management drugs and a nerve-pain device sharing surgical and orthopedic customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: specialty sales force selling to hospitals and surgery centers; distributors / dealers: specialty pharmaceutical distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA drug approval and device clearance for its injectable and device products

notes: Manufacturing sites and the share of sales made abroad through partners are not fully certain.
